_readMeFirst: This describes the CURRENT reviewed synthetic/local baseline, not the final target architecture. The Streamarkr build plan target remains Vite + Cloudflare Worker + D1 (+ optional R2) + real provider adapters. The current IndexedDB/fake-provider implementation is temporary and preserves validated product behavior while that migration is done in focused builds.

absoluteRules: No live network calls to any provider from the synthetic baseline
No deploy or Cloudflare production action without explicit authorization
No real/personal data in automated QA or fixtures
Never overwrite user-owned data from a provider-refresh code path
Never commit a real API key, OAuth secret, token, or credential of any kind
knownSchemaMigrationNotes: Current IndexedDB availability key [titleId, serviceKey] cannot represent multiple simultaneous option types for the same service; redesign this provider-owned table during D1 schema migration before live-provider integration.
